notes.title: Patch Notes V0.25.0
notes.content:
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] FIXED: Inventory is not persistent anymore when you die and retry.
[*] FIXED: A bug when you die and retry, you lost your objectives and wouldn't interact with the pharmacist.
[*] FIXED: The alarm sound will now power off when you die.
[*] FIXED: The pharmacy music will now stop if you go to the main menu.
[*] FIXED: You can now see your cursor or use the controller on the game over screen
[/list]

[h2]General improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] NPCs: improved conversations.
[*] UI: Game over screen now lets you see the player's death.
[*] AI: Enemies will stop firing at you when you are dead.
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you lose dialog focus, pause/unpause the game.
[*] The camera is wrong for 0.5 seconds if you choose to go directly to Bones after the Pharmacist dialog.
[*] Enemies will forget about you too quickly when you hide.
[*] Some players got stuck walking in place towards the camera, trying to exit a room while not perfectly aligned with the door.
[*] Checkpoints are not saved correctly. You could spawn at the wrong place when loading a game.
[/list]

[b]Thanks for playtesting![/b]
Don't forget to fill the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfMvRpEVVzygklfvCIlwa8oms4HF9G9j5ng1i-43_nIGijJGQ/viewform]feedback form[/url]. It helps a ton!

Did I mention that there is a Discord server you can join and give more feedback? Let's meet! https://discord.gg/46NZQUGpY8

Val@AffectusGames

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.23.0
notes.content:
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "Click here to skip" button on the dialog screen. Replaced by the keyboard key or controller button information to skip
[*] Fixed lighting in the pharmacy level interiors
[*] A new method is now used to prevent Mac users from getting a black screen. [b]Please go in the settings in the main menu and ensure that the 1st full screen option is selected[/b]. It seems that this is a Unity issue, so I'm not sure it will work. Please let me know!
[/list]

[h2]General improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pharmacy: Other floors are now hidden while you are not within them
[*] Pharmacy: Improved performances drastically
[*] The security cam now stops if you leave the floor area (Many thanks to the person who told me that in the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfMvRpEVVzygklfvCIlwa8oms4HF9G9j5ng1i-43_nIGijJGQ/viewform]feedback form[/url]!)
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you lose dialog focus, just pause/unpause the game
[*] Pharmacy: If you loot the gun in the computer room, you can't equip it after you leave the room. You must gon into the inventory, unequip/equip it again
[/list]

Thanks for playtesting!
Don't forget to fill the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfMvRpEVVzygklfvCIlwa8oms4HF9G9j5ng1i-43_nIGijJGQ/viewform]feedback form[/url], it helps a ton!

notes.content:

[*] Some Mac users could have a black screen at the beginning of the game. Sometimes it's fixed by clicking buttons or changing the resolution
